description: D_PDUs addressed to another node, or to a group this node does not belong to, are not acted on: nothing is delivered and no WARNING is queued.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). All from 0.0.1.3, address size 4, EOW 0, EOT 10. At 2000: a single-segment type 7 to 0.0.1.9, individual (C_PDU ID 1, window 0, DATA S_PDU SAP 9 to SAP 5, U_PDU "x1"); a type 7 whose destination value is this node's address 0.0.1.2 but with GROUP ADDRESS set (C_PDU ID 2, U_PDU "x2"), a group it does not belong to (C-0339); a DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, start and end flags, 1-byte segment) to 0.0.1.9, which would draw a WARNING if it were addressed here. None drives this node's state machine (C-0566), so there is no output, and with nothing queued the burst end starts nothing.
